entities.name: 3-Nitro-4-methylbenzonitrile
observations: Decoded SELFIES substrate has canonical SMILES Cc1cc(C#N)ccc1[N+](=O)[O-] and formula C8H6N2O2.
The substrate contains an aromatic nitro group, nitrile, and methyl substituent.

entities.name: 3-Amino-4-methylbenzonitrile
observations: Proposed product from selective reduction of the aromatic nitro group to an aniline; the nitrile is retained.

entities.name: SnCl2 AcOH nitro reduction
observations: Tin(II) chloride in acidic aqueous medium, followed by ammonium hydroxide workup, is consistent with reducing an aromatic nitro group to an aniline.
